_comment: Filled in by a person. Allowed results: PASS, FAIL, NOT_TESTED. Leave NOT_TESTED for anything you did not actually do. Do not edit 'expected'.

keyboard.ime: name, and whether it was on/off per item

items.expected: piero starts; alternate screen is entered; three-pane layout is drawn without stray characters
j/k, h/l and arrow keys move; Enter enters a folder; Parent column follows
Japanese and long file names: pane separators '|' stay in their columns on every row
dragging the window size: screen redraws correctly, no residue, no flicker storm
'.' toggles hidden files; '/' filter accepts typing, Backspace edits, Enter keeps, Esc clears
Space selects and moves down; status bar shows 'selected N (visible V, hidden H)'; Esc clears selection
'?' opens help; Esc closes it
y on a synthetic file, go to ANOTHER disposable folder, p: copy completes; destination bytes and SHA-256 match the source
y on a file, p in the SAME folder: preflight refuses the same-folder copy; original unchanged and no copy created
q quits; cursor visible again, normal screen and scrollback intact, no leftover alternate-screen text
Ctrl+C quits cleanly and restores the terminal
closing the tab/window while piero runs: it closes promptly, no piero.exe left in Task Manager
JIS keyboard, IME OFF: '/', '?', '.' work as commands
IME ON: Japanese typed into the '/' filter arrives as the confirmed text; Esc leaves filter mode
p0_terminal --mode confirm-test: hold 'x' for 2 s (real key repeat) -> modal opens, YES never fires from the repeats
open the modal with 'x', mash 'Y' immediately: nothing fires in the first 300 ms; after that 'y' fires once
Esc cancels the modal immediately, also inside the guard window
IME ON with the modal armed: typing a Japanese character does not fire YES; the IME hint appears; Esc cancels
width-matrix: the 'resynced' marker is in column 41 on EVERY row, whatever the text is
items.note: write down which rows show a drifting 'naive' marker

items.expected: width-matrix: half-block row (▀▄█) renders as solid blocks with no gaps/overlap in this terminal
confirm-test at 80x24, 60x20, 40x15, 40x12, 20x8: verb and destination visible; below 20x8 the full-screen 'CONFIRM: Y/N'
